newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower across the board on Tuesday, as price falls on CBOT overnight corn trading exacerbated the bearish tone, local traders said.
Prices were 150 to 490 yen lower, with the benchmark September 1997 contract down 150 yen to 16,000 yen a tonne. Daily volume was 72,123 lots.
All months fell from the opening session as active selling from individual investors, who were discouraged by the weaker CBOT corn market over the weekend, emerged, the traders said.
"The selling accelerated in the afternoon as CBOT corn continued to ease," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.11-1/2 per bushel at 0820 GMT, against the $3.13-1/4 price at Monday's close.
The spot November of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.95 at 0820 GMT, against the $7.98-3/4 price from Monday's close.
